answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax of 40 POA before it can trade. The fee is burned, never refunded, so a voyage of 1,000 fake identities costs 40,000 POA up front — more than spam earns back. The ledger echoes each payment publicly, exposing duplicate patterns to all peers. Honest agents pay once and trade for years, while attackers hit a basalt wall of sunk cost per new identity. The tax is twice average weekly earnings, so forgery never pays.
